verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a first-party Reusable Content feature: admins create Markdown blocks that appear across multiple pages, and editing a block updates every instance automatically. That covers the snippet half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows content variables for writers; the CSS variables and API-key/server-variable injection are adjacent features, not reusable text variables. missing for 10: documented content variables (e.g., product names or versions substituted across pages), detail on snippet parameters and nesting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical writer, reusable snippets and variables keep repeated content in sync across pages

citations.quote: Reusable Content lets ReadMe Admins create Markdown blocks that appear across multiple pages. When you edit a block, the system updates all instances automatically.
